[MBA-SM] Post Graduate Programme in Sustainable Management stresses upon the philosophy that businesses are embedded in society and cannot be separated from it, and therefore aims to develop management professionals with a holistic perspective on economic, social and environmental issues. In addition to offering general management courses, PGPSM's curriculum stands out in management education by means of offering specialized courses on systems thinking, social entrepreneurship, externalities, lifecycle management, stakeholder management and public policy.

Objectives of the Programme

- To build an understanding of contemporary challenges that businesses are facing in the 21st century, with emphasis on the environment

- To impart appropriate skillsets to integrate principles of sustainability and responsible management practices in
- To acquire knowledge and skills in key functional areas of businesses
- To encourage entrepreneurial capabilities and develop a global perspective

Why Sustainable Management

Businesses today are increasingly being driven by sustainability concerns. Results of surveys conducted by many leading consulting and media houses such as Forbes and Fortune indicate that no business can survive in future without incorporating sustainability principles and practices in its operations. However, this is easier said than done. Here in lies the role of Sustainable Management.

While in the past, 'sustainability' as a term was often associated and limited to environmental and social concerns, a hard realization has set-in in the recent years that businesses cannot separate themselves from society and environment. An unstable social and environmental ecology will inadvertently hurt the profit bottom line of business by making the conduct of business expensive. Hence, the only way to deal with the threat of negative environmental and sociological impact of business is to convert them into opportunities of improvements and excellence.

The PGPSM enables future managers to understand the ever evolving and interactive nature of these sustainability challenges and come up with integrated, holistic solutions.

725:[] Mahatma Gandhi National Fellowship (MGNF) is a flagship programme launched by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). It includes 660+ Fellows in different districts. MGNF is a two-year certificate programme in Public Policy and Management with Nine IIMs- Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Lucknow, Jammu, Kozhikode, Nagpur, Ranchi, Udaipur, and Visakhapatnam as academic partners. IIM Lucknow is one of the Academic partners for the program having at present 109 fellows in four states including 33 in Assam, 11 in Mizoram, 54 in Uttar Pradesh, and 11 in Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the programme is to strengthen the district skill landscape of the country through an effective and collaborative engagement of Fellows. MGN Fellowship aims to create a cadre of individuals who can contribute to the strengthening of the district-led skill ecosystem. This will help in supporting the district administration to improve skill development, programme delivery as well as develop a cadre of committed and competent development leaders.
726-
727:MGNF is a Online learning programme with on campus Academic Modules and District Immersion Modules. The academic module provides conceptual clarity on ideas relevant to skilling, management and development economics among other things through intensive classroom teachings, exam format assessments, and discussions.

Program Overview

What is the blended MBA (b MBA) program at IIM Lucknow?
The b MBA is a two-year post-graduate management program designed for working professionals and entrepreneurs. It blends live online learning with on-campus immersion, offering flexibility while maintaining the academic rigor and structure comparable to IIM Lucknow's regular PGP.
How long is the b MBA program?
The program spans two years, divided into six terms. Each term is approximately four months long.
What are the standout features of the blended MBA program at IIM Lucknow?
  • Strategically designed to help professionals maintain a healthy balance between work, life, and learning
  • A degree-granting, rigorous blended format MBA by a top B-school in India
  • Designed for working professionals at all levels across India and abroad
  • Combines live online sessions with immersive on-campus modules
  • Access to IIM Lucknow faculty, library, and learning tools
  • Peer learning through group work, case studies, and discussions
  • Recognized alumni status after successful completion
  • Option to complete the program within 3 years (Subject to approval)
How does IIM Lucknow’s blended MBA structure align with or differ from conventional Executive MBA formats?
The b MBA offers a structured mix of live online classes and campus immersions, emphasizing academic depth, faculty engagement, and peer learning. The program is delivered by IIM Lucknow faculty and mirrors the rigor of the institute’s flagship full-time offerings.
How does the Blended MBA program match up with the institute’s other full-time degree programs?
The b MBA maintains comparable standards in curriculum design, faculty involvement, assessment, and final degree. It is aligned with IIM Lucknow's PGP, ensuring consistency in quality and academic expectations.
Who will benefit the most from this program?
The b MBA is ideal for mid- to senior-level professionals and entrepreneurs seeking to transition into leadership roles, grow their ventures, or develop strategic business acumen without taking a career break.
Does the program offer any specializations during the second year?
Yes, participants can choose from a wide array of electives across multiple management domains. While there is no formal specialization degree, participants can tailor their learning journey based on interest and career goals.
Does the program allow flexibility in completion timelines?
Yes. While the standard duration is two years, participants may request an extension to complete the program within three years, subject to the approval of the Program Executive Committee.

Eligibility and Admissions

Who is eligible to apply for the b MBA program?
have a minimum of three years of full-time work experience post-graduation, and hold a bachelor's degree (minimum 50% marks) or equivalent professional qualification.
Is international work experience considered in eligibility?
Yes, international full-time work experience is valid, provided it meets the requirement of three years post-qualification experience.
Can foreign nationals apply?
Yes. Foreign nationals must submit valid GMAT/GRE scores and have their degrees recognized from reputed universities.
What test scores are accepted for admission?
Valid scores (within five years) from CAT, GMAT (including GMAT Focus Edition), or GRE are accepted. Only center-based tests are considered.
What is the admission process like?
The process includes evaluation of academic qualifications, test scores, work experience, and an online personal interview. Final selection is based on a composite score.
Is it mandatory to obtain a No Objection Certificate from the current organization?
No, an NOC is not mandatory. However, candidates must submit a valid experience certificate.
Do b MBA students have access to global exchange opportunities offered under the PGP?
No, the b MBA program does not include an international exchange component.

Program Schedule and Calendar

When does the program begin?
Inauguration is scheduled for September 25, 2025, with classes starting from September 26, 2025.
What is the schedule of classes during the weekdays and weekends?

Classes are typically held on Thursday, Friday, Saturday evenings (6:30 pm to 9:45 pm) and Sunday mornings (10:00 am to 1:15 pm). In Year 2, some electives may be scheduled on Sunday afternoons (2:15 pm to 5:30 pm). Sunday (additional): 1 session, for quizzes etc. if required.

If a scheduled session coincides with a gazete or public holiday on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, the class will be conducted on an alternative weekday (Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday) from 6:30 PM to 9:45 PM.

If a class falls on a holiday, when will it be rescheduled?
In case of a public holiday on a scheduled class day, the session will be shifted to Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday evening (6:30 pm to 9:45 pm).
What is the frequency of on-campus immersion modules during the program?
Participants visit the IIM Lucknow campus four times across two years. In Year 1: 13 days (4+9); In Year 2: 15 days (9+6).
What does the on-campus immersion cover? -- DPM duration section --

Programme duration and Accommodation

PhD is a full-time residential programme. The candidate admitted to the first year is expected to complete the programme in four and half years. The candidate admitted to the second year is expected to complete the programme in three and half years. The students spend their first two years for course work and the last two years and six months for research and thesis preparation.

Campus hostel facility is available for stay of married students with their immediate family (spouse and children).
